verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own diarization docs say it can separate a transcript into distinct channels as well as speakers, which directly covers per-channel transcription so each side of a call stays separate. The support rests on a single summary line with no further detail. Missing for 10: details on stereo/multichannel input handling and channel labeling, realtime vs batch availability of channel diarization, output format examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate

citations.quote: Use Speechmatics' Diarization to separate a transcript into distinct speakers or channels, so you can clearly see who said what.
